helpers.HeadersMixin.content_type.summary: Returns the parsed content type from HTTP headers, ensuring it's up-to-date.

helpers.TimeoutHandle.__call__.summary: This function iterates through a list of callbacks, executes each with its arguments, suppresses exceptions, and then clears the list.

helpers.TimeoutHandle.__init__.summary: Initializes a timeout handler with a loop, timeout, and threshold, setting up callbacks.

helpers.TimeoutHandle.close.summary: Clears all callbacks associated with the timeout handle.

helpers.TimeoutHandle.register.summary: Adds a callback with its arguments to the internal list of callbacks.

helpers.TimeoutHandle.start.summary: Starts a timer that calls a method after a specified timeout, rounding up if timeout is above a threshold.

helpers.TimeoutHandle.timer.summary: Checks timeout, creates and registers a timer if timeout is positive, otherwise returns a no-op timer.

helpers.TimerContext.__enter__.summary: Enters a timeout context by checking task existence, version compatibility, cancellation status, and appending task to list.

helpers.TimerContext.__exit__.summary: This function checks for task cancellation and timeout, managing context exit accordingly.

helpers.TimerContext.__init__.summary: Initializes a timer context with an event loop, setting up tasks list and cancellation flags.

helpers.TimerContext.assert_timeout.summary: Checks if timer is cancelled and raises TimeoutError if so.

helpers.TimerContext.timeout.summary: Cancels all tasks if not already cancelled and marks context as cancelled.

helpers.TimerNoop.__enter__.summary: This function returns the instance itself when entering a context, acting as a no-op timer context.

helpers.TimerNoop.__exit__.summary: This function does nothing when exiting a block, ignoring any exceptions.

helpers._basic_auth_no_warn.summary: Constructs a BasicAuth object without triggering deprecation warnings by directly creating a tuple.

helpers._weakref_handle.summary: This function checks if an object is still alive through a weak reference, then safely calls an attribute method on it.

helpers.basicauth_from_netrc.summary: Retrieves and returns BasicAuth credentials for a host from a netrc object, raising LookupError if none found.

helpers.calculate_timeout_when.summary: Calculates timeout execution time, rounding up if timeout exceeds ceiling threshold.

helpers.call_later.summary: Schedules a callback to run later if timeout is positive, using the event loop.

helpers.ceil_timeout.summary: Calculates a timeout based on delay, rounding up if it exceeds the threshold.

helpers.content_disposition_header.summary: Sets MIME Content-Disposition header, validating and quoting params as needed.

helpers.encode_basic_auth.summary: Encodes login and password into a Base64 string for HTTP Basic Auth, raising an error if login contains a colon.

helpers.get_env_proxy_for_url.summary: Checks if proxying is allowed for the URL host; retrieves proxy info from environment; returns proxy and auth if found, else raises LookupError.

helpers.guess_filename.summary: Tries to guess a filename from an object's name attribute, returning it if valid; otherwise, returns a default.

helpers.is_canonical_ipv4_address.summary: Checks if a string is a valid canonical IPv4 address with four octets, each 1-3 digits without leading zeros or exceeding 255.

helpers.is_ip_address.summary: Checks if a host string resembles an IP address by looking for colons or numeric characters.

helpers.netrc_from_env.summary: Attempts to load a netrc file from an environment variable or default home directory location, returning None if not found or fails to parse.

helpers.noop.__await__.summary: This function is an asynchronous no-op, yielding control without performing any action.

helpers.parse_content_type.summary: Parses a Content-Type header, returning the media type and parameters as a tuple.

helpers.parse_mimetype.summary: Parses a MIME type string into its main components and parameters.

helpers.proxies_from_env.summary: Extracts and processes HTTP/HTTPS proxy settings from environment, ignoring secure schemes and adding auth from netrc if available.

helpers.quoted_string.summary: Formats 7-bit ASCII content into a quoted-string, escaping non-text characters.

helpers.rfc822_formatted_time.summary: Returns current time formatted as RFC 822 date string, caching result for efficiency.

helpers.set_exception.summary: Sets an exception on a future or protocol if it's not already done, optionally chaining exceptions.

helpers.set_result.summary: Sets the result of a future if it hasn't already completed.

helpers.strip_auth_from_url.summary: Removes user and password from URL, returning cleaned URL and BasicAuth object if present.

helpers.weakref_handle.summary: Schedules a weak reference cleanup if timeout is positive, rounding time up if threshold is reached.
